entries.name: Intractable posteriors to amortized continuous latents to discrete codebooks
entries.predecessor_bottleneck: Directed generative models with continuous latents had intractable posteriors and required per-datapoint inference, blocking large-data training (D001).
entries.changed_representation: Amortized Gaussian encoder q(z|x) with continuous latent code (D001); then discrete codebook latents via nearest-neighbour quantisation with straight-through gradients (D002).
entries.changed_architecture: MLP encoder/decoder with reparameterised sampling (D001); strided-conv encoder plus residual blocks plus autoregressive decoder with EMA codebook updates (D002).
entries.changed_objective: ELBO/SGVB with analytic KL (D001); log-likelihood given quantised codes plus codebook plus commitment losses (D002).
entries.changed_sampling_or_inference: Ancestral sampling via recognition model without MCMC (D001); MAP quantisation plus ancestral sampling from a separately fitted PixelCNN/WaveNet prior (D002).
entries.conditioning_or_control_change: NOT_ESTABLISHED
entries.source_supported_improvement: AEVB beats wake-sleep on lower bounds (D001); discrete codes avoid posterior collapse under powerful decoders and reach 49.3% phoneme mapping at ~25 Hz speech (D002).
entries.tradeoff_or_new_failure_mode: Gaussian-posterior example only, discrete latents excluded (D001); no joint prior training, uniform prior during representation learning, MSE pixel blur (D002).
entries.successor_inheritance_or_displacement: VQ-VAE discrete thesis inherited by VQGAN/codecs/video tokenisers (see T-REP-02, T-REP-04, T-REP-06).
unresolved: Downstream compression-fidelity quantification needs first-stage autoencoder sources.

entries.name: Single-scale discrete codes to hierarchical and perceptual-adversarial tokenizers
entries.predecessor_bottleneck: Single-scale VQ-VAE latents could not reach high-fidelity large-image generation (D002).
entries.changed_representation: Two-level discrete maps (256px: 32x32 top plus 64x64 bottom conditioned on top; FFHQ-1024 adds 128x128) (D003); CNN VQGAN codebook (|Z|=1024; 256x256 to 16x16 indices) with perceptual plus patch-discriminator losses (D004).
entries.changed_architecture: Feed-forward conv encoder/decoder with PixelSnail priors (D003); VQGAN encoder-decoder plus GPT-2-medium latent transformer with sliding window (D004).
entries.changed_objective: Stage-1 VQ reconstruction plus codebook plus commitment, stage-2 PixelCNN NLL on frozen codes, classifier rejection sampling (D003); VQ objective plus adaptive-weight GAN plus transformer NLL (D004).
entries.changed_sampling_or_inference: Top-prior then bottom-conditioned sampling with single feed-forward decode ~30x faster than pixel-space (D003); autoregressive next-index prediction with sliding window, temperature/top-k (D004).
entries.conditioning_or_control_change: NOT_ESTABLISHED
entries.source_supported_improvement: CAS Top-1 54.83 (58.74 after reconstruction) vs BigGAN-deep 42.65; FID ~30 to ~10 with rejection (D003); CIFAR-10 +18.63% FID at 14.08x faster sampling vs pixels; COCO-Stuff FID 22.4 (D004).
entries.tradeoff_or_new_failure_mode: Latent-space likelihood not comparable across encoders; rejection trades diversity (D003); sliding window needs spatial invariance; fixed 16x16 context (D004).
entries.successor_inheritance_or_displacement: Tokenizer quality bar inherited by latent-diffusion first stages (see T-PAR-07).
unresolved: Recorded D004 locator 2012.09812 is a transcription defect; body consumed at verified-correct 2012.09841.
Reconstruction-vs-generation split needs first-stage vs prior ablations.

entries.name: Unconditional discrete tokens to text-conditioned visual tokens
entries.predecessor_bottleneck: Discrete representation learning lacked joint text conditioning at scale (D002-D004).
entries.changed_representation: dVAE 256x256 RGB to 32x32=1024 tokens x8192 vocabulary concatenated with BPE text (<=256 tokens) as a single stream (D005).
entries.changed_architecture: dVAE conv encoder/decoder with bottleneck plus Gumbel-softmax; 12B sparse decoder-only transformer (64 layers, row/column/conv masks, distributed sharding) (D005).
entries.changed_objective: Joint evidence lower bound with KL weight 6.6; prior cross-entropy weighted text 1/8 plus image 7/8 on argmax tokens (D005).
entries.changed_sampling_or_inference: Autoregressive sampling plus CLIP-contrastive best-of-512 rerank, gains plateauing after ~32 (D005).
entries.conditioning_or_control_change: Text conditioning via joint token stream (training-time); CLIP rerank at inference (D005).
entries.source_supported_improvement: MS-COCO zero-shot human vote 90.0% realism plus 93.3% caption match vs DF-GAN; FID within ~2 pts of best prior; 21% COCO / 12% CUB train overlap with no result change (D005).
entries.tradeoff_or_new_failure_mode: Heavy compression loses high-frequency detail; CUB specialist gap; rerank-dependent; variable binding/text rendering inconsistent (D005).
entries.successor_inheritance_or_displacement: Text-conditioned discrete precedent displaced by VQGAN/CLIP-latent successors for fidelity (unresolved in consumed body).
unresolved: dVAE ceiling vs VQGAN/CLIP-latent successors needs successor sources.

entries.name: Speech codecs to residual-vector-quantised neural audio codecs
entries.predecessor_bottleneck: Single-codec single-rate designs could not serve speech/music/general audio at speech-codec bitrates with on-device latency (D006).
entries.changed_representation: Causal convolutional embeddings downsampled 320x (75 frames/s at 24 kHz) quantised by residual vector quantisation with constant-D additive refinement enabling variable layer counts (D006); multistream RVQ with adversarial/perceptual losses (D007); stride-512 embeddings at 86 Hz with 9x10-bit factorised normalised RVQ at ~91x compression (D008).
entries.changed_architecture: SEANet-like causal conv encoder/decoder with FiLM denoising conditioning (D006); streaming conv encoder-decoder plus LSTM plus per-bandwidth multi-scale STFT discriminator plus optional Transformer LM with arithmetic coding (D007); SoundStream-style encoder/decoder with Snake activations plus multi-period plus complex-STFT discriminator, no k-means/restarts (D008).
entries.changed_objective: Hinge adversarial plus feature-matching plus mel-spectral reconstruction end-to-end (D006); L1 time plus multi-scale mel plus hinge GAN plus relative feature-matching plus commitment via gradient balancer (D007); multi-scale log-mel L1 plus HingeGAN plus feature-match plus codebook/commitment with quantiser dropout (D008).
entries.changed_sampling_or_inference: Streamable causal inference with selectable layer count for target rate (D006); 13.3 ms initial latency, RTF ~9.8 enc/10.4 dec (D007); variable-rate first-n codebooks coarse-to-fine (D008).
entries.conditioning_or_control_change: NOT_ESTABLISHED
entries.source_supported_improvement: MUSHRA 3 kbps beats Opus 12 kbps and Lyra 3 kbps, nears EVS 9.6 kbps (D006); streamable MUSHRA 1.5-12 kbps from 49.2 to 90.6 with 25-40% entropy trims (D007); 8 kbps mel/STFT/ViSQOL/SI-SDR beats EnCodec-12k on all four; matched-24 kHz 12 kbps bests EnCodec (D008).
entries.tradeoff_or_new_failure_mode: Crowdsourced (not strict) MUSHRA; constant-rate operation; music hardest (D006); discriminator-overpower handling; 48 kHz plus entropy coding slower than real-time (D007); still below reference MUSHRA; balanced full-band sampling required (D008).
entries.successor_inheritance_or_displacement: RVQ codec thesis inherited by codec language models (see T-SP-03) and controllable music (T-MU-02).
unresolved: Matched rate/quality frontier across the three codecs needs a single matched comparison.

entries.name: Acoustic-only tokens to semantic-plus-acoustic hierarchy
entries.predecessor_bottleneck: Acoustic-only modelling babbles; semantic-only tokens cannot vocode (D009).
entries.changed_representation: Hybrid semantic tokens (self-supervised audio encoder layer-7 k-means K=1024 at 25 Hz, ~250 bps) plus acoustic SoundStream tokens (12x1024 RVQ at 50 Hz, 6000 bps; 4 coarse=2000 bps plus 8 fine) (D009).
entries.changed_architecture: Frozen tokenisers plus three 0.3B decoder-only Transformers in stages (semantic, coarse-acoustic, fine) (D009).
entries.changed_objective: Next-token likelihood per stage (semantic, then coarse acoustic flattened row-major, then fine on short chunks) (D009).
entries.changed_sampling_or_inference: Continuation from 3-second prompt (semantic extend plus coarse-acoustic extend plus fine pass plus codec decode) with staged temperatures; acoustic-generation and unconditional modes (D009).
entries.conditioning_or_control_change: NOT_ESTABLISHED
entries.source_supported_improvement: Semantic-250 bps ABX 6.7/7.6 vs acoustic-2000 bps 22.4/28.7; acoustic continuation ASR CER 3.4/WER 6.0; speaker accuracy 92.6% on continuation vs 3.2% on resampled semantics (D009).
entries.tradeoff_or_new_failure_mode: Proper-noun/background-noise ASR errors; piano beyond-speech only continuations (D009).
entries.successor_inheritance_or_displacement: Separation thesis inherited by MusicLM semantic/acoustic staging (see T-MU-02) and VALL-E codec-LM speech (see T-SP-03).
unresolved: Long-form structure beyond continuations needs MusicLM/MusicGen successors.

entries.name: Image tokenizers to spatiotemporal video tokenizers
entries.predecessor_bottleneck: Image tokenizers lack temporal compression; video generation needed short discrete sequences for long clips (D002, D010).
entries.changed_representation: 3D-VQ video to 4x16x16=1024 tokens for 16x128x128 frames (codebook 1024) with inflated 2D-VQ initialisation (D010).
entries.changed_architecture: BERT transformer (128M/464M variants; task-prompt plus class plus 1024 visual tokens) trained with COMMIT multivariate masks (D010).
entries.changed_objective: Multi-task cross-entropy sum over 10 tasks (frame prediction, interpolation, inpainting variants, class-conditional) (D010).
entries.changed_sampling_or_inference: Non-autoregressive COMMIT decoding in 12 steps (16x128x128 in 12 steps, 0.25 s on TPU, 37 fps on V100) (D010).
entries.conditioning_or_control_change: NOT_ESTABLISHED
entries.source_supported_improvement: UCF-101 FVD 332 to 76(L)/159(B); BAIR frame-prediction FVD 84 to 62 (31 debiased); Kinetics-600 frame-prediction 16.2 to 9.9 (~39% cut); ~100x diffusion sampling efficiency (D010).
entries.tradeoff_or_new_failure_mode: VQ fidelity bounds generation; fixed 16-frame training; naive unmasking fails (COMMIT motivation) (D010).
entries.successor_inheritance_or_displacement: Compressed discrete video thesis feeds variable-length generation claims; masked-prior vs diffusion-prior comparison unresolved.
unresolved: Masked-prior vs diffusion-prior comparison needs successor coverage.

entries.name: Research video VAEs to high-compression open video VAE with consumer-GPU execution
entries.predecessor_bottleneck: Video VAEs imposed VRAM/latency walls blocking consumer-GPU high-definition generation (D010, D012).
entries.changed_representation: High-compression 4x16x16 temporal-height-width VAE (64x) plus patchification to 4x32x32 total (D012).
entries.changed_architecture: 2-expert mixture-of-experts layout plus TI2V-5B dense unified model; diffusion training with FSDP/Ulysses (README-level disclosure) (D012).
entries.changed_objective: NOT_ESTABLISHED (no training loss in consumed README bytes).

entries.conditioning_or_control_change: NOT_ESTABLISHED

entries.tradeoff_or_new_failure_mode: Open line stops at 2.2; later versions API-only; README gives no VAE reconstruction/ablation numbers (D012).

entries.name: Intractable likelihood to adversarial implicit models to stable convolutional GANs
entries.predecessor_bottleneck: Likelihood-based training needed tractable densities or MCMC; backprop-friendly implicit modelling was missing (D013).
entries.changed_representation: Implicit generator distribution via samples G(z) with no explicit density, evaluated via Parzen windows (D013); 100-dim uniform noise to convolutional stacks (D014).
entries.changed_architecture: MLP generator plus MLP discriminator with alternating SGD (D013); strided-convolution discriminator / fractional-strided generator, no pooling/FC, batchnorm, Adam 0.0002 (D014).
entries.changed_objective: Minimax with non-saturating generator loss; optimum at matched distributions (D013); standard adversarial minimax with deduplicated LSUN (D014).
entries.changed_sampling_or_inference: Single forward pass G(z), no Markov chain (D013); discriminator conv features reused for downstream classification (D014).
entries.conditioning_or_control_change: NOT_ESTABLISHED
entries.source_supported_improvement: Parzen MNIST 225±2 vs DBN 138±2 (D013); CIFAR-10 82.8% classifier probe; SVHN-1000 22.48% error vs 28.87% supervised same-architecture (D014).
entries.tradeoff_or_new_failure_mode: No explicit density; synchronisation requirement with mode-collapse risk; high-variance Parzen eval (D013); occasional filter-collapse with longer training (D014).
entries.successor_inheritance_or_displacement: Adversarial thesis retained in vocoders/autoencoders/post-training hybrids (see T-SP-02, T-RT-01); displaced as standalone image SOTA by diffusion (see T-PAR-04).

entries.name: Unconditional GANs to style control to quality redesign
entries.predecessor_bottleneck: Early GANs lacked disentangled control and carried droplet/blob and location-preference artefacts (D015, D016).
entries.changed_representation: Mapping network z to intermediate space W with per-layer styles plus stochastic noise maps (D015).
entries.changed_architecture: 8-layer MLP to W with AdaIN from learned constant (D015); revised synthesis with bias/noise outside style block, std-only modulation, weight demodulation, skip-generator plus residual-discriminator, no progressive growing (D016).

entries.changed_sampling_or_inference: Scale-specific style mixing, W-space truncation, fresh noise resampling for stochastic detail (D015); single forward generation with projection optimisation for attribution (D016).
entries.conditioning_or_control_change: Style-mixing control at scales; truncation as fidelity-diversity knob (D015).

entries.name: Latent-variable images to fully autoregressive pixels to transformer autoregression
entries.predecessor_bottleneck: Tractable full joint p(x) without latent-inference intractability; capturing long-range pixel dependencies scalably (D017).
entries.changed_representation: Row-major factorisation with RGB split and 256-way multinomial per channel (D017); raster autoregression with 256-value embeddings per channel plus 2D coordinates, categorical or discretised-mixture densities (D018).
entries.changed_architecture: Row-LSTM / Diagonal-BiLSTM up to 12 layers plus masked-conv PixelCNN and multi-scale variants (D017); decoder-only Transformer (unconditional/class) and encoder-decoder for super-resolution with masked local multi-head self-attention (D018).
entries.changed_objective: Discrete negative log-likelihood in bits/dim (D017); maximum likelihood sum over positions (D018).
entries.changed_sampling_or_inference: Parallel training, sequential pixel-by-pixel generation with inpainting by conditional sampling (D017); sequential categorical sampling with temperature 0.8-1.0; class-conditional and 8x8-to-32x32 super-resolution decoding (D018).
entries.conditioning_or_control_change: NOT_ESTABLISHED
entries.source_supported_improvement: MNIST 79.20 nats; CIFAR-10 3.00 bits/dim; ImageNet-32 3.86 / ImageNet-64 3.63 (D017); CIFAR-10 2.90 bits/dim; ImageNet average 3.77; super-resolution fooled rate 36.11±2.5% (D018).
entries.tradeoff_or_new_failure_mode: Sequential generation expensive; 64x64 single-scale weak global structure (D017); local attention truncates full context; largest generation 32x32 plus super-resolution (D018).
entries.successor_inheritance_or_displacement: Autoregressive prior thesis inherited by VQGAN/PixelSnail priors and codec language models (see T-REP-02, T-SP-03); displaced for images by diffusion on cost grounds.

entries.name: GAN dominance to diffusion quality with score-matching equivalence
entries.predecessor_bottleneck: Diffusion models lacked high-quality-sample demonstration; GANs led on ImageNet/LSUN (D019, D030).
entries.changed_representation: Latents x1:T same dimensionality as data with discrete decoder integral for 0-255 data; progressive reconstruction estimate (D019).
entries.changed_architecture: Pixel UNet like unmasked PixelCNN++ with group normalisation, Transformer sinusoidal time embedding, self-attention at 16x16, shared across t=1000 linear-schedule steps (D019); improved UNet with 128 base channels, multi-resolution attention, BigGAN resblocks, AdaGN timestep-plus-class conditioning (D030).
entries.changed_objective: Simplified unweighted epsilon-prediction objective down-weighting small-t terms vs true variational bound (D019); Nichol hybrid simple-plus-variational-bound with learned variance interpolation (D030).

entries.name: Markov-chain diffusion sampling to implicit non-Markovian few-step sampling
entries.predecessor_bottleneck: DDPM needs a 1000-step Markov chain (~20 h/50k CIFAR-32, ~1000 h/50k 256px on stated GPU) (D020).
entries.changed_representation: Same marginals with non-Markovian joint via sigma vector; predicted clean sample from noisy input (D020).

entries.changed_objective: Same DDPM training objective; sampling varies the stochasticity parameter (0 deterministic, 1 DDPM-like) (D020).
